mode: headless Rust integration tests; no Tauri run(), desktop app, Explorer, mouse or keyboard automation

tests.name: killed_copy_worker_retains_committed_data_and_unpublished_staging
tests.method: Parent spawns its own Rust test worker with CREATE_NO_WINDOW and BELOW_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS; worker copies an 8 MiB synthetic source, signals after the first 1 MiB, and is killed and reaped by its parent.
verified: SQLite integrity and committed references/tags survive
completed target and both sources retain exact bytes
partial staging remains recorded and unpublished
later clean exit clears session references only and retains staging

tests.name: windows_sharing_conflicts_fail_safely_and_copy_holds_source_and_root
verified: exclusively opened source yields Windows sharing error 32
copy denies concurrent source writer and bound-root rename
successful copy retains exact source/target bytes
writer/rename access is released after copy completes

suite.fixture_note: The crash worker entry is invoked by its parent test; candidate preparation remains opt-in. These are not unimplemented acceptance cases.

limits: Does not test resource-exhaustion or arbitrary ACL denial
Does not test Windows GUI file picker, OLE drag/drop, DPI or multiple monitors
Does not replace native acceptance of the exact candidate binary
